status: drafted, unfrozen; pre-freeze review complete, fixes applied, gate and check re-running
why_this_exists: 0021 read REAL_FIT_FAILS with 0014's model M4 at 0.1193 on the real-family rows, the depth-3 tree at 0.0929 and the standardised logistic L3 at 0.1179, all fitted UNSEARCHED on real content, and its scope deferred 'what a recipe searched on real content would do (the search is a different preregistration)'. This is that preregistration: 0014's roster and selection rule run inside 0021's real fit block, symmetric, with the bar floored at 0021's readings.

design_decisions.decision: the holdout is a chunk-id rule (mod 5 == 0) on the fit block, not a draw
design_decisions.why: 0014's convention; a rule cannot be re-drawn
design_decisions.consequence: 5291 holdout rows over 206 chunks, py_src-heavy ({'c_src': 130, 'pe_bin': 1014, 'py_src': 3471, 'rfc_txt': 468, 'rst_doc': 208}); selection ranks by the holdout mixture, disclosed in scope.holdout

design_decisions.decision: one selection stage on the whole fit pool, keep 1
design_decisions.why: 0014's two stages existed because its pool was 639227 rows and stage 1 fitted 100000; here the fit pool is 21055 rows, so a second stage would refit the same rows

design_decisions.decision: the logistic head is in the frozen bar set
design_decisions.why: 0014's convention and OPERATING_RULES 4a; 0021 had excluded it from its floor and banked L3 as a sister recipe. The strictest reading in the record, stated in scope.the_bar_and_why_the_logistic_is_in_it

design_decisions.decision: each baseline head is floored at 0021's banked reading of its reference recipe (deep_tree at 0.0)
design_decisions.why: a searched baseline can raise the bar and never lower it below where 0021 measured it (0014's floors, moved to real content)

design_decisions.decision: four reproduction arms (M1, M4, L3, D1 on the whole fit block) within 0.005 of 0021's banked readings, aliased to a head's own confirmatory fit when that head selected the reference recipe
design_decisions.why: ties the run to 0021's machinery and to its numbers; no recipe is fitted twice on the same rows
design_decisions.consequence_found_by_the_gate: the first control selected M4 for the model head and read 0.20: the reader voided it on the aliased reproduction (drift 0.0807). A deterministic refit of M4 on the same rows reads what 0021 read, so a model head that selects M4 is pinned to 0.1193 and cannot clear - the search can only clear through a recipe other than M4. The control now selects M3; a case keeps the aliased path as a clean REAL_RECIPE_FAILS

design_decisions.decision: the null control permutes the whole fit block's labels with the split's own generator at the same state 0021 used
design_decisions.why: the permuted array is 0021's and its hash is sealed as an expectation, one more tie to 0021

design_decisions.decision: scoring on the concatenated [260000 eval + 61409 ext] set, 0021's layout
design_decisions.why: reuses 0021's readings shape and reader logic; the reverse reading on builder content comes for free

design_decisions.decision: per_family over the families present in the scoring set (5 real on the holdout; 8 builder + 8 'ext:' on the confirmatory set)
design_decisions.why: run_recipe_search.score() names the builder's eight families, which the holdout does not contain; the runner replaces the scorer at import and the reader recomputes per_family over sorted(set(fam_s))

instrument.runner: tools/pivot/run_realsearch.py (fit_block_partition() module-level so the generator and the pre-freeze check call it)
instrument.reader: tools/readers/realsearch4096_verdict.py, generated from the preregistration by a template; 30 result keys; exception path writes all of them
instrument.gate: tests/mutation_test.py realsearch4096: 75 cases, control built from tests/fixtures/realsearch_runner_shape.json (a smoke of the runner) with sealed values via _rf_sub/_shape_fill; provenance case symmetric at every level
instrument.pre_freeze_check: tools/prereg_checks/prefreeze_0022.py: rebuilds the corpus blocks and the fit-block partition by calling the runner, asserts reader keys are runner keys, per-record requirements against the fixture, fixture currency, nothing exists yet, a real run refuses on an unfrozen file
gate_evolution: v1: 3 cases, control selected M4 -> VOID on the aliased reproduction (design fact, not a defect)
v2: 75 cases, 71 detected: a shared environment dict between records and the launch block, and selection-file mutations applied after the file was hashed into the ledger
v3: per-record environment copies; sel_mutate applied before hashing: 74/75 (a record's params dict shared with the roster)
v4: params copied per record, roster deep-copied: 75/75

v5 (after the review): the control's roster takes its key set from the fixture in both files; five cases added (aliased L3 and D1 pass at their references, every head aliased is a clean REAL_RECIPE_FAILS, an aliased logistic outside tolerance is VOID, the provenance fail twin); the fixture recaptured under the sealed roster

cost.estimate_stated_in_advance: about one hour at three threads (selection about 40 min, confirmation about 20 min); COULD NOT VERIFY until run
cost.smoke: select 322 s wall (39 s of fits; the rest is the cold builder-cache memmap for the 260000-row identity scan), confirm 68 s

pre_freeze_review.method: four independent adversarial readings, one lens each, run in parallel before the freeze: instrument (reader against runner), condition (clause and design), runner (operations and resume), claims (every number and clause text against the banked artifacts). Nothing sealed was found wrong by any lens; the reader's arithmetic was replayed on the runner's own smoke output with zero discrepancies; the null-label hash and every fit-block hash were recomputed from the data with the runner's own code by three of the four lenses.

adopted.finding: the prose confirm order in design.stage_confirm and arms[1] was 0014's (majority, stratified, best_single_feat, depth3_tree, deep_tree, logistic), not the sealed confirm_order the reader enforces (frozen heads before the expanded ones)
adopted.fix: both sentences rewritten to the sealed order

adopted.finding: the launch rule 1-minute load <= 2.0 refuses an honest confirm launched right after select (the three fit threads' load decays for about a minute) and any launch while the gate suite runs
adopted.fix: the sealed threshold is unchanged; the runner re-samples the load every 15 s for up to five minutes before refusing, banks the seconds waited, and the invocation says confirm is launched when the box is idle

adopted.finding: relaunching a completed confirm is not refused and rewrites the banked artifact (launch_number, timestamps, duplicate selection_bound events)
adopted.fix: the confirm stage refuses when the artifact on disk is complete

adopted.finding: the selection file is written non-atomically; a kill mid-write leaves a truncated file that the next select refuses and the next confirm crashes on
adopted.fix: written to .tmp then os.replace, as the artifact and scores are

adopted.finding: the runner banks the null-label hash but does not compare it to the sealed 0021 value; a divergent permutation would be found by the reader after the model was fitted
adopted.fix: NOT RUN before the null fit when the hash is not 0021's

adopted.finding: an aliased reproduction arm on a baseline head is never drift-checked by the runner, so the same drift is NOT RUN under one selection outcome and VOID under another
adopted.fix: after each baseline head's fit the runner applies the tolerance to any arm that head aliases; on the model head only the reader can, as VOID, and stop_rules say so

adopted.finding: a completed confirmatory record deleted from disk is NOT RUN at any point (shared machinery: one scoring per role), which stop_rules did not list
adopted.fix: listed

adopted.finding: the pre-freeze check spawns a real-mode select expecting the unfrozen refusal; from a shell exporting the sealed thread count against a frozen file it could start a real selection
adopted.fix: the probe forces one thread so it can never pass the launch check (and the check exits 2 on a frozen file before reaching it)

adopted.finding: the captured fixture predated the current preregistration (its roster carried a heads_source key since moved out of the sealed roster; its roster_sha256 was not the sealed one) and neither the gate nor the check could see roster-level drift
adopted.fix: fixture recaptured from a smoke under the sealed roster; the check requires the fixture's roster to be exactly {protocol, heads} in both files and its banked roster_sha256 to be the sealed one; the control takes the roster's key set from the fixture in both files

adopted.finding: gate coverage: no fail twin for the provenance case; only the M4 aliasing path exercised
